name: Weapon Designer
author: Oddisz
description: Design your own weapons at a colony whose Orbital Works, or a building upgraded from it, holds a Pristine Nanoforge (or a Tenebrian Nanoforge from Vaults of Knowledge). Pick the mount size, mount type, damage type, projectile (ballistic, laser, beam or missile) and the look of any loaded weapon, then buy the stats with weapon OP. The weapon OP a design uses is what it costs to mount. Saved designs join your custom production.
